# scripts/Cinema/CineShot.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Cinema/CineShot.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Pure framing calculations from actor transforms/activity: shot kind, size, world position/look/subject, FOV, focus, near blur.
FOV is vertical degrees; focus is metres. Context keys and supported kinds are in docs/systems/cinematics.md.
Uses interpolated drawn transforms to align framing with the rendered actors; does not validate placement against physics.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.

## Functions

### frame

```gdscript
static func frame(kind: StringName, men: Array, context: Dictionary) -> Dictionary
```

[Source:44](../../../../../scripts/Cinema/CineShot.gd#L44)

Returns framing {kind,size,position,look,fov,focus,subject,near_blur} for a kind and Node3D subjects.
Context supplies aspect/side/from/place/toward/target/step and held framing. Positions are world-space; FOV is degrees, focus metres.
Unknown kind falls back to medium; caller must validate physics placement and supply subjects suitable for the requested kind.

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `StringName` | required |
| `men` | `Array` | required |
| `context` | `Dictionary` | required |

Return type: `Dictionary`.

### drawn_at

```gdscript
static func drawn_at(node: Node3D) -> Vector3
```

[Source:129](../../../../../scripts/Cinema/CineShot.gd#L129)

Where `node` is drawn this frame: between its physics ticks (the engine's
interpolation) on a screen drawing faster than they come, so the camera
follows a man as he is seen and not a tick behind in steps (the judder
up close); where it is when nothing interpolates.

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | `Node3D` | required |

Return type: `Vector3`.
